character:
FEEL: Quiet and exact. The materials speak in short, level sentences and leave a lot of air around everything they show, so the brand reads as calm confidence rather than excitement. Nothing shouts; emphasis comes from placement and restraint.

DEVICES: A single warm accent used sparingly against a pale paper ground; generous margins; product pictures cropped close so one surface or edge fills the frame; thin rules that separate rather than decorate.

COLOUR, TYPE, SPACE AND IMAGERY: The paper colour is the ground in almost every marked material, the ink colour carries all text, and the accent appears on one element at a time, never as a fill behind copy. Headlines are set large and tight with plenty of room below them; body text stays small and regular. Space is the main material: roughly two thirds of each surface is left empty. Pictures are daylight photographs of the product in use, close and unstaged.

NEVER: It never stacks several accents, never fills a surface edge to edge with colour, never uses exclamation or hype, and never shows the product as a floating cut-out without its surroundings. The evidence about motion is thin.
